links.outcome: AI AUC versus MR-US fusion biopsy on data from an institution that supplied no training data
links.effect: Heat Map AUC 0.76 (95% CI 0.70, 0.82), radiologist PI-RADS 0.73, ROI 0.71. No significant difference from radiologists (heat map p=0.38, ROI p=0.43).
links.quote: Neither the XProstate Heat Map (AUC difference = 0.03, 95% CI: -0.04, 0.10, p = 0.38) nor the XProstate ROI (AUC difference = -0.02, 95% CI: -0.09, 0.04, p = 0.43) was significantly different from the radiologist PI-RADS score.

links.outcome: AI versus clinical radiologist PI-RADS discrimination on the same cases
links.effect: Heat map AUC 0.76 versus PI-RADS 0.73 (difference 0.03, p=0.38). ROI AUC 0.71 (difference -0.02, p=0.43). Neither AI output differed significantly from radiologists.
links.quote: Neither the XProstate Heat Map (AUC difference = 0.03, 95% CI: -0.04, 0.10, p = 0.38) nor the XProstate ROI (AUC difference = -0.02, 95% CI: -0.09, 0.04, p = 0.43) was significantly different from the radiologist PI-RADS score.

unlisted_practices: Comparing AI output formats (algorithm-generated ROIs versus whole-gland heat maps) for diagnostic performance
Testing AI on studies acquired with an endorectal coil that were absent from the training set

screen.reason: The study conducts a retrospective external validation of a deep learning prototype (XProstate) for prostate cancer detection on MRI using true external institutional data, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
